images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5 blockbuster poster micro-story at a cloud-level aviation skyport at blue hour. An attractive adult Korean Shorthair cheese-tabby cat; natural balanced sturdy build; bright warm orange short coat with realistic darker tabby stripes; clean white fur on muzzle and chin continuing naturally through neck, chest and belly; all four paws clean white from toes upward; a distinctive congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around the mouth resembling a curry stain, explicitly not food or dirt; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. The cat is a dark bat-themed rooftop vigilante in an original charcoal cape and practical harness with no emblem, showing astonished silent gasp and hugging a giant prop, front paws wrapped around an oversized transparent porcelain teacup. Inside the cup, a tiny diver stands beside a white sugar-cube iceberg while projected red security laser beams form a harmless vault grid; the cat reaches toward a glowing geometric vault portal behind the hero. Airships, docking towers, and a recognizable cloudport silhouette establish scale. Rain droplets visibly rise from a puddle into the clouds, creating the twist, with safe compositing and forced perspective. Three-quarter front viewpoint, camera distance eight meters, slightly elevated crane angle, 28mm lens, deep focus on cat and portal with gentle atmospheric falloff, cool moonlight mixed with warm amber dock lamps, realistic fur, paws, whiskers, porcelain reflections, cloud shadows, and physically coherent contact. Dominant clean silhouette, one decisive action, safe staged photography, no danger. Correct feline anatomy, no duplicate cats, no extra limbs, no human features, no cartoon, illustration, 3D render, plastic fur, logos, text, watermark, UI, captions, or readable title.
